notes: 21 October user-directed correction: server MCQ preparation removed. Explicit approved grade payload/save/return retained; legacy proposal/report access remains read-only. See existing-api-migration/local-assessment-correction-2026-10-21.md.
All Sakai access uses the authenticated host MCP connection; there is no external importer or client login.
Tools return typed metadata and SDK ResourceLinks. File/report contents use resources/read or the SDK EmbeddedResource fallback tool.
Native REST DTOs remain v1 and are validated separately. JSON Schema does not grant permissions or academic approval.

tools.name: save_assignment_grades
tools.description: Validate or save exactly approved point grades and feedback without releasing; explicit TA approval required for commit. Unknown outcomes require reconciliation; never replay blindly.

tools.name: release_assignment_grades
tools.description: Validate or return selected saved grades and synchronize their verified external Gradebook projection; separate release approval required. Unknown outcomes require reconciliation; never replay blindly.

tools.name: get_assignment_grades
tools.description: Independently read exact Assignment and linked Gradebook values for selected targets.

tools.name: get_assignment_grading_operation
tools.description: Read and reconcile a known principal-bound save or release receipt without committing pending work.

tools.name: prepare_assignment_grade_payload
tools.description: Construct the canonical hash and validate one exact save or release-and-return payload without committing. Review commit_arguments with the TA; invoke the separate save/release tool only after explicit approval. No external hashing script is needed.

tools.name: list_assignments
tools.description: List published assignments the delegated grader can grade, without requiring assignment-setup permissions.

tools.name: get_assignment_grading_proposal
tools.description: Read a durable grading proposal and its frozen configuration, including reconciliation after an uncertain prepare result. No academic writes.

tools.name: read_assignment_grading_resource
tools.description: Read one Sakai grading resource through the existing authenticated MCP connection, for hosts that expose tools but not resources/read. Returns SDK EmbeddedResource content. No external download or login.
